body:
Troubleshooting a bit further...

I even went back to the version I used when I wrote that article and played with the `rest-fights` app & I see the same error.

I've put together some smaller yamls that can be imported via `oc apply -f` which only contain the `rest-fights` service showing the issue. I'm deploying on [Red Hat Developer Sandbox](https://developers.redhat.com/developer-sandbox/get-started), as described in the blog post.

[rest-fights-java17.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/8631508/rest-fights-java17.zip)

If you unzip this there is a single folder `rest-fights-java17`. Inside are 2 yaml files: `rest-fights-quarkus-2.7.3-java17.yml` and `rest-fights-quarkus-2.8.2-java17.yml`.
- `rest-fights-quarkus-2.7.3-java17.yml` is for Quarkus `2.7.3`, which is the version I used when I created [the blog post](https://developers.redhat.com/articles/2022/03/23/quarkus-superheroes-managed-services-save-day), so I know this worked!
- `rest-fights-quarkus-2.8.2-java17.yml` is for Quarkus `2.8.2`, the most recent version of the app. They both suffer from this problem.

Before deploying either you first need to [create the managed services as described in the blog post](https://developers.redhat.com/articles/2022/03/23/quarkus-superheroes-managed-services-save-day?source=sso#creating_managed_services).

> **NOTE:** For this simple example you **ONLY** need to create the `rest-fights` service account & permissions on the services.

Then before deploying the app (via `oc apply -f`) you need to update a few values in the respective yaml file:
- In the `rest-fights-config` ConfigMap (1st element in the yaml document) you need to update the values:
    - `kafka.bootstrap.servers`: Update `<kafka-bootstrap-server>` with the bootstrap server of your Kafka managed service
    - `mp.messaging.connector.smallrye-kafka.apicurio.registry.url`: Update `<service-registry-core-registry-api>` with the core registry API URL of your service registry service
- In the `rest-fights-config-creds` Secret (2nd element in the yaml document) you need to update the values:
    - `CLIENT_ID`: Update `<rest-fights-client-id>` with the Client ID of the service account you created
    - `CLIENT_SECRET`: Update `<rest-fights-client-secret>` with the Client secret of the service account you created

Then `oc apply -f` the one you want to deploy and wait for everything to start up (in my instructions below I'm assuming the `2.7.3` version - the only difference with the `2.8.2` version, besides dependency updates, is swapping in MongoDB instead of PostgreSQL.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/363447/166929345-59fe7f8c-88cf-47d6-a441-ba3893e49e48.png)

Everything should start up fine. Then click the route icon on the `ui-super-heroes` app to bring up the UI

![Screen Shot 2022-05-05 at 9 08 59 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/363447/166929690-d7fb77be-9b28-4781-bd1f-d6ba32fbcbc1.png)

You should see fallback hero & fallback villain (because we did not deploy the rest of the system). Just click `Fight!`

![Screen Shot 2022-05-05 at 9 10 21 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/363447/166929905-9768c4f5-fdad-411d-a59c-3f0b69a6661e.png)

Then go and look at the pod logs for the `rest-fights` pod:

Just to follow up. I had a conversation with @carlesarnal offline and he suggested to upgrade the version of `io.apicurio:apicurio-common-rest-client-vertx` to version `0.1.9.Final` as some changes had been made on the apicurio side. After doing that (via https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-super-heroes/commit/5eb0696c89643523fe26f57762fc4714af67bc0f) everything seems to be fine.

I'm closing this, but we should get the version of `io.apicurio:apicurio-common-rest-client-vertx` updated in Quarkus.

issue.title: Update `apicurio-common-rest-client-vertx` version

labels.name: area/dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

issue.body:
Update `apicurio-common-rest-client-vertx` version to the most recent version. The current version (`0.1.9.Final`) does not work with some versions of apicurio. `0.1.11.Final` does, and is being used already. See https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-super-heroes/blob/280ba7d522d8f3a30a809cd92c8c89987276d8f9/rest-fights/pom.xml#L104-L122

Specifically see https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/25378#issuecomment-1118669593

Closes #25378

body: @geoand I've re-opened this & proposed a PR to update the `apicurio-common-rest-client-vertx` version. See #26322
Cool, although I can't say I know anything about the topic 🙂

issue.body:
In `rest-fights` & `event-statistics`, remove the need for overriding to a custom version of `io.apicurio:apicurio-common-rest-client-vertx`

Waiting on quarkusio/quarkus#25378 which will be released in Quarkus 2.11.0
